correctness.rationale: The exact face complex has f-vector (8,24,16) and 1133 degree profile. A 16-by-17 integral H1 presentation has rational rank 16 and gcd 2 of its maximal minors, proving H1 is Z plus Z/2. A primitive cofactor cocycle gives free coordinate 0 on eight and absolute value 1 on twelve of the exactly twenty empty triangles. Mod-two reduction has quotient dimension two and every empty triangle is nonzero; its three nonzero quotient classes have multiplicities 8,6,6. These exact computations are replayed by verify.py.

value.rationale: The 1133 complex is a canonical member of the complete vertex-minimal Klein-bottle classification. The result identifies exactly how the shortest possible simplicial cycles detect both the torsion element and the two primitive free torsion-cosets in integral H1. This is structural cycle information not supplied by minimality, f-vector, or global homology alone.
